questions.question: Which policy decision is hard-coded into InstallationToken.can?
options: It denies every pull_request.open action
It grants force_push when the token is less than one hour old
It denies force_push and any write:main action
It denies read-only issue access but permits writes to main
questions.explanation: can returns False for force_push and for actions beginning with write:main; ordinary scoped actions remain allowed by this local policy.

questions.question: What per-repository daily PR limit does BudgetLedger enforce?
questions.explanation: daily_pr_cap defaults to 5, and permit rejects a repository once prs_today[repo] reaches that number.

questions.question: Which hard cap can make run_agent fail even if the model keeps making progress?
options: 20 turns, $20, or 30 wall-clock minutes, whichever is reached first
Only a 5-PR repository cap
A 50-token output limit per turn
Only a coverage delta below zero
questions.explanation: run_agent checks turn_cap=20, dollar_cap=$20.0, and minute_cap=30.0 after each turn and sets the corresponding failure.

questions.question: When does run_verify set failure="coverage_regression"?
options: When CI is green and coverage increases by less than 0.6
When the sampled coverage_delta is below -2.0
Whenever a test is flaky, regardless of coverage
When the PR count reaches five
questions.explanation: After the flake check, run_verify samples coverage_delta and rejects only values less than -2.0; it otherwise advances the run to PR.

questions.question: Which condition directly makes open_pr fail in the local implementation?
options: The token has a pull_requests:rw permission
The task title contains the word fix
The installation token is expired
The run reached the VERIFY state
questions.explanation: open_pr first checks time.time() against token.expires_at and sets token_expired when the installation token is no longer valid.

questions.question: What aggregate result does the seeded dispatcher print for 20 tasks?
options: 5 PRs opened and 15 failures
20 PRs opened and no failures
7 PRs opened and 13 failures
13 PRs opened and 7 failures
questions.explanation: With random.Random(9), the demo reports 13 PRs opened and 7 failed runs across the 20 dispatched issues.
